what_was_done: Upgraded HTML drawers (#sdca-lab and #ops-console) to native Popover elements.
Replaced junior manual scroll height sizing in JS with CSS field-sizing: content for the textarea (#user-inp), adding feature-detection fallbacks in js to avoid layout thrashing on modern browsers.
Updated CSS drawer styles with :popover-open pseudo-selectors, @starting-style entry/exit transforms, and transition discrete behavior (allow-discrete).
Modernized sdca-lab.js and ops-console.js drawer toggle states to trigger native Popover show/hide APIs wrapped inside document.startViewTransition().
Kept the .open class list synchronized with popover states in JS to preserve compatibility with existing end-to-end browser smoke test selectors.
Integrated window.scheduler.yield() inside the telemetry event parsing loop in init.js to maintain thread responsiveness and minimize INP (Interaction to Next Paint) latency.
Fixed click-outside double-trigger toggle drawer bugs by shifting popovers to popover='manual' mode in HTML.
Defaulted window.SZ_SHOW_DEBUG_CARDS to true in state.js, making the F51 multi-agent telemetry pipeline cards visible in the UI chat window.
